subject: Startups
title: Rituals That Build Identity
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Rituals That Build Identity.

hook.text: Every Friday, Shopify holds a 'town hall.' Stripe has a weekly email celebrating customer wins. Rituals build belonging.

buildup.text: Culture rituals are repeated practices that reinforce values: all-hands meetings, demo days, onboarding traditions.

discovery.text: Amazon's 'Day 1' philosophy starts every all-hands by reading the original mission.

twist.text: Forced fun backfires. Mandatory karaoke or awkward team-building events can erode culture instead of strengthening it.

climax.text: The best rituals emerge organically and reflect genuine values. You can't fake authenticity with a calendar invite.

punchline.text: Rituals work when they feel real, not required.

quiz.question: What is Amazon's 'Day 1' philosophy?
options: A reminder to maintain startup mentality
